*   **Realme Buds Classic Wired in Ear Earphones with Mic (Black)**

response_text: Realme Buds Classic Wired in Ear Earphones with Mic (Black) at ₹399 are the best in class right now. 4000+ hours playtime, Tizum+ cable that is super tough and the sound quality is excellent for the price. Realme customer service is also top notch.
